children: Lisk has confirmed that Lisk Chain shuts down, and users must bridge their funds to Ethereum before closure. Withdrawal takes about 8 days, with unstaking adding a 3-day waiting period, so a complete move can span roughly 11 days. The deadline applies to all LSK holders on the chain.

This is a forced, supply-wide migration with a hard cutoff. Holders who start the process late face a timing constraint, because funds still inside the 8-day withdrawal or 3-day unstaking window may not complete their transfer before the chain stops. That points to repositioning and exit pressure in the token as the shutdown approaches, since bridging to Ethereum is the only route for balances held on Lisk Chain.
Reminder: users holding funds on Lisk Chain must bridge to Ethereum before its closure on October 31st.
Unlocking and unstaking adds another 3-day waiting period.
Lisk stakers can now unlock their staked LSK, with no penalty (link in bio).

title: Lisk: Chain Shutdown Requires Holders to Bridge Funds to Ethereum - 31 Oct 2026
